subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract for text model failover here, and which public shape should it use?
rationale: The request changes provider/model routing, auth-profile behavior, and config semantics; the code path is clear, but wildcard/auto refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, and catalog-derived fallbacks are distinct product contracts.

options.title: Keep Design Open
options.body: Keep this issue open and choose one canonical core fallback contract before starting or landing implementation work.

options.title: Narrow To Catalog-Derived Fallbacks
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 as a separate narrower path after it is repaired and proven, while leaving wildcard/auto and fallbackFamilies undecided.

options.title: Reject Core Surface
options.body: Close this after a maintainer decides explicit fallbacks plus plugin hooks are enough and provider-family fallback policy should stay outside core config.

recommendation.title: Keep Design Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and choose one canonical core fallback contract before starting or landing implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: Most history on the central model fallback/config files points to this owner, and the remaining question is a product/config contract decision for that path.
